verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents context beyond the diff in several ways. It auto-applies repository guideline files (.cursorrules, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) and learned team preferences as review criteria, which covers existing conventions. Linked multi-repo analysis detects breaking changes and API mismatches across repository boundaries. The only beyond-diff code analysis is AI Deep Scan, which is separately metered and limited to security findings. Beyond the vague 'context-aware' claim, nothing shows that ordinary PR review comments analyze call sites or related modules within the same repository. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of same-repo call-site or dependency-graph analysis during PR review, evidence of how the codebase is indexed for review context, and independent hands-on corroboration that comments reflect code outside the changed hunks.
